# The BASIC-156 + PEAKS-72 additive slice (944 layout: f0..155 + f156..227).
# The ZERO-marginal-compute half of benchmarks/free_features_2026-09-01.md's free
# set: the 72 peaks are already computed unconditionally by fused_vblur_ssim_inner*
# and shipped by V1PoolsMode::Peaks, so emitting them costs nothing measurable
# (that doc's 2.1: every CI straddles 1.0). The 37 raw-moment slots this slice
# LEAVES OUT are the ~1%-of-walk-time half (its 2.2) and the ones with the
# 9.12%% real-pixel route-parity miss (free_features_classC_2026-09-04.md 6.2).
